name: Yamamoto Mayako
source:
Grade: 1st year, Yuzuki Group

Mayako’s a cute little girl who is a friend and classmate of [url=/c13091]Inori[/url]’s. She’s very active and bright and a little clumsy, but that can be overlooked because she always smiles in the end.

[Edited from [url=http://accany.wordpress.com/2009/05/31/花と乙女に祝福を-review/]Accany's review[/url]]
